Device selection uses ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR; it only takes effect if the program uses a default/selector-based sycl::queue.
Static text scan: macros that expand to dpct:: calls, or helpers reached through user-defined wrappers, are not detected.
Zero helpers means the code no longer depends on dpct headers; it does not prove the code is correct or fast. Run compile + verify + benchmark.
